title: Slowly migrating from 2d to 3d with Claude. Also stupidly happy with the cows :)
author: Dead_Fox_7
selftext:
Had a less the pleasant experience trying the same thing with Astra and just assumed it was out of scope atm for me. Tried it with Claude and it was a very different experience. Sampled Godot, Unity and then Unreal before finally settling on Unreal and couldn't be happier so far. 

So far Claude has done a great job at getting all the basic mechanics in like setting up the pathing for the fields to be harvested, basic needs, lining up the day and night cycles, and animating the cows based off of reference videos. 

Still a ton to put in and artwork is still almost entirely placeholder, but it still feels SO good to sit back and watch it actually working.

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body: Nice how did this pipeline work ??

replies.author: Dead_Fox_7
replies.body:
Thanks! Using MCP inside Unreal. I write down what I want for each system (farming, building, animals and so on), and Claude Code reads the project docs, writes the C++ and adds tests. Then it launches the game off-screen and takes screenshots to check its own work. I play it, give notes, and we go round again until it’s right.

The MCP setup made a huge difference. Most of the terminology is still very new to me, but happy to discuss more in depth with what I know

replies.body: Nice!! 😊 the first part was 2d? Or also 3d? Because that also looks nice
